verdict.rationale: Undermind's core interaction is natural language. Users give an open-ended research goal, it asks clarifying follow-up questions, and users can iterate and brainstorm conversationally. Through its MCP server, chat agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot can also drive search, full-text Q&A, note editing, folder curation and starring. Community reports confirm that long natural-language prompts work better than keyword fiddling and that the follow-up questions are useful. Missing for 10: no evidence that account, workspace and alert settings can be managed through natural language, as opposed to research and library actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis.
Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
Brainstorm with an AI expert that has read the relevant literature. Generate custom tables to support your research.
Once connected, begin a new chat and type `@Undermind`.
Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace.
